turns.q: My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
turns.replyTail: : I’m sorry that happened. If your tracking shows Delivered but you didn’t receive it, please share your order number (it starts with #) so I can check the carrier details. In the meantime, it can help to: - Check around your delivery location (porch/garage/mailroom) and with neighbors/household members - Look for a delivery notice or photo (if your carrier provides one) - Contact the carrier/local delivery office to confirm the exact drop-off location and whether it was left with someone nearby
